ruleDefinitions.name: Disable of ETW Trace - Powershell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of powershell cmdlets to disable or remove ETW trace sessions Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-EtwTraceProvider\\ .*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-EtwTraceProvider\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x11.*")))
